pages.title: Carbon Nanotube Bundle
pages.text: Graphene sheets rolled seamlessly into tubes a few nanometres across, then twisted together into a rope. Each tube is far stronger than steel; the bundle feels like silk and refuses to snap. Pulled taut, it sings faintly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Graphene curled on its own along the edges of an orbital lattice, so I gave it more lattice and an ionic liquid to roll in. The tubes came out closed and clean, and twisted into rope as they dried.
